1946, October 22
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten orig- inal by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
SERAFHIC MASS ASSOCIATION FOR THE SUPPORT OF THE CAPUCHIN FORETGN MISSIONS
DEAR FRIEND OF THE MISSIONS: October 22nd 1946
MAY THE LORD GIVE YOU HIS PEACE!
I WISH TO THANK YOU SINCERELY FOR YOUR KIND AND GENEROUS ALMS TO THE CAPUCHIN FOREIGN MISSIONS. I AM SURE THAT THE PRAYERS OF THE MISSIONARIES WILL ASCEND TO THE THRONE OF GOD FOR YOUR WELFARE.
UNDER SEPARATE COVER I AM MAILING YOU THE CER- TIFICATES OF ENROLLMENT, WHICH I TRUST YOU WILL LIKE.
GRATEFULLY YOURS IN CHRIST,
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
(Reverse Side of Card, written in Fr. Solanus' hand, to wit:
October 22, 1945 St. Felix Monastery Huntington, Ind.
V. Bro. Leo, O.F.M. Cap. St. Bonaventures
Detroit, Mich.
Dear Brother Leo: God bless you and all.
Thanks be to God I am sure we all enjoyed our little "day off" to St. Bonaventures and to our Lady of Prompt Succor, etc. We arrived back at St. Felix at 6:05 p.m. Deo Gratias. However, we would hardly be Capuchins if some one of the crowd did not forget something. Possibly you found the trousers I left in the corner room, where you found the hat yesterday a.m. I hope you have them on their way hither, if not I would ap- preciate your sending them on as soon as convenient. Before I thought of it, we were well on our way to St. Felix. Praised be Jesus, O.F.M. Cap.
